result.rationale: The diff's parseRefreshTokenResponse sets refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token" when the minimum schema (used in sharing mode) doesn't include a real refresh_token. Zoom's VideoApiAdapter.ts now uses parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseBody, zoomRefreshedTokenSchema), and the Google/office365 paths persist the parsed result to prisma.credential. In sharing mode the zoom refresh path will therefore validate against the minimum schema and the placeholder refresh_token can be persisted as the credential key, breaking subsequent refreshes. judged_text: In sharing mode zoom's refreshed token is parsed with minimumTokenResponseSchema, so parsedToken.data is {access_token, refresh_token: "refresh_token"} which the existing credential-update path persists as the new key. The zoom credential's real refresh_token is overwritten in the DB with the placeholder string; the next refresh sends refresh_token=refresh_token to zoom.us and the integration dies permanently with no error at sync time.
